name: Chariot 500SC Fungicide
uses: botrytis on roses and angular leaf spot on French beans
targets: Botrytis (grey mould) on roses and angular leaf spot on French beans
settings: Agricultural and floriculture: rose farms, greenhouses and French bean fields
lead: Chariot 500SC is a carbendazim fungicide that controls botrytis (grey mould) on roses and angular leaf spot on French beans. It protects flowers, buds, stems, leaves and pods in greenhouses and open fields before disease ruins the crop.
method: Shake the container well, half-fill the tank with water, add the measured product, top up and keep agitating while you spray. Cover leaves, buds and stems evenly.
extraSteps: Begin when conditions favour disease (cool, humid, still air) rather than waiting for heavy damage, and improve airflow in greenhouses and between plants.
Rotate with fungicides from other chemical groups and keep to the number of sprays on the label so the product keeps working.

name: Compliant 560SC Fungicide
uses: mildew, leaf spot and rusts on roses, cabbages and beans
targets: Powdery and downy mildew on roses; leaf spot, black leg and club root on cabbages; rusts, anthracnose and angular leaf spot on French beans; coffee berry disease
settings: Agricultural: flower farms, vegetable and bean fields, and coffee
lead: Compliant 560SC combines azoxystrobin and chlorothalonil in one broad-spectrum fungicide. It controls powdery and downy mildew on roses, leaf spot, black leg and club root on cabbages, rusts and anthracnose on French beans, and coffee berry disease.
method: Shake well, half-fill the tank with water, add the measured product, top up and keep agitating while you spray. Cover leaves, stems, pods and berries evenly.
extraSteps: Start protection early, before disease is widespread, and repeat at the label interval while humid weather, heavy dew and frequent rain favour disease.
Rotate crops, use clean seed and healthy seedlings, and keep spray and rinse water away from streams, ponds and drains: chlorothalonil and azoxystrobin can harm fish.

name: Covver Xtra 500SC
uses: fungal infections and crop disease control
targets: Fungal infections in crops (comprehensive disease control)
settings: Agricultural: field crops (crops and diseases to be confirmed on the label)
lead: Covver Xtra 500SC is an advanced fungicide for comprehensive control of fungal infections in crops. Used as a protective spray programme, it helps keep plants healthy and protects yield and quality.
method: Mix and apply exactly as the manufacturer's label directs, shaking the container well and agitating the tank while you spray. Never mix with other products unless the label allows it.

name: Infinito SC 687.5 Fungicide
uses: downy mildew and blight in tomatoes, potatoes and roses
targets: Downy mildew, late blight and related blight diseases in roses, tomatoes, potatoes, onions and vegetables
settings: Agricultural: vegetable, potato and onion fields, tomato growers and rose farms
lead: Bayer Infinito SC 687.5 is a dual-action fungicide that combines fluopicolide and propamocarb against downy mildew and blight diseases. It protects roses, tomatoes, potatoes, onions and vegetables when cool, wet, humid weather makes disease spread fast.
method: Shake well, half-fill the tank with water, add the measured product, top up and keep agitating while you spray. Cover leaves, stems and fruits evenly.
extraSteps: Begin a protective programme before disease is widespread and stay alert when the weather turns cool and wet.
Follow the label on how often and how many times it can be used in a season, and rotate with fungicides from other groups.

name: Mastercop 60SC Copper Fungicide
uses: fungal and bacterial diseases on tomatoes and beans
targets: Fungal and bacterial diseases on tomatoes, beans and other vegetables (protective control)
settings: Agricultural: small and medium farms, kitchen gardens and greenhouses
lead: Mastercop 60SC is a copper-based protective fungicide for fungal and bacterial diseases on tomatoes, beans and other vegetables. It forms a protective layer on leaves and stems that helps stop spores and bacteria before they enter the plant.
method: Mix as the label directs and spray evenly so leaves and stems are covered. Do not spray in strong wind or just before rain.
extraSteps: Apply before disease becomes heavy and scout the crop regularly: this is a protective product.
Use copper in rotation with other fungicide groups, especially in wet, humid weather when blight, leaf spots and bacterial problems spread fast.
labelNeeded: copper content and active ingredient name

name: Milestone Extreme 390 SC Fungicide
uses: blight, downy mildew and powdery mildew
targets: Blight, downy mildew and powdery mildew in vegetables, potatoes and other crops
settings: Agricultural: commercial and small-scale vegetable and potato growers
lead: Milestone Extreme 390 SC is a dual-action systemic fungicide for blight, downy mildew and powdery mildew. It is taken up by the plant to protect tissue inside the leaf and new growth, which suits commercial and small-scale growers in wet, humid and cool weather.
method: Mix as the label directs and spray evenly over the crop at the first sign of disease or in high-risk weather.
extraSteps: Alternate fungicides with different modes of action through the season and keep to the number of sprays on the label.
Remove infected plant material, rotate crops, plant in well-drained fields and allow air to move between plants.

name: Milthane Super Fungicide
uses: blight and leaf spots on potatoes, tomatoes and vegetables
targets: Early and late blight and leaf spots on potatoes, tomatoes and vegetables (protective, contact action)
settings: Agricultural: potato and tomato farms and vegetable plots
lead: Milthane Super is a mancozeb wettable powder fungicide for protective control of blight and leaf spots on potatoes, tomatoes and vegetables. The 1 kg pack is easy to measure and well suited to regular preventive spraying.
method: Mix into clean water as the label directs and spray in the early morning or late afternoon, covering both sides of the leaves evenly.
extraSteps: Spray before disease arrives or at the very first signs: mancozeb protects rather than cures.
Rain can wash the product off, so follow the label on spray intervals and re-application after heavy rain, and avoid breathing the dust.

name: Revus 250SC
sizes: single pack; size on the label
uses: fungal infections and crop disease control on farms
targets: Fungal infections in crops (crop disease control)
settings: Agricultural: field crops (crops and diseases to be confirmed on the label)
lead: Revus 250SC is a fungicide for crop disease control that helps protect plants from fungal infections. Used in a regular spray programme, it supports yield and quality.
method: Mix and apply exactly as the manufacturer's label directs, shaking the container well and agitating the tank while you spray. Never mix with other products unless the label allows it.

name: Rimeta Gold 300SC Fungicide
uses: botrytis in roses and early blight in tomatoes
targets: Botrytis (grey mould) in roses; early blight and soft rot in tomatoes and French beans
settings: Agricultural: flower farms, greenhouses, tomato and French bean growers
lead: Rimeta Gold 300SC combines carbendazim and pyrimethanil in a dual-action systemic and contact fungicide. It controls botrytis in roses and early blight and soft rot in tomatoes and French beans, protecting flowers and vegetables before they reach the market.
method: Mix as the label directs and spray evenly over leaves, flowers and fruits at the first sign of disease or when conditions favour it.
extraSteps: Improve air movement with good spacing and ventilation, avoid wetting flowers and leaves late in the day, remove infected plant parts and clean tools.
Follow the label on the number of sprays and rotate with fungicides from other chemical groups.

name: Tecto 500SC Fungicide
uses: foliar disease prevention and botrytis in roses
targets: Botrytis (grey mould) in roses and foliar diseases
settings: Agricultural and floriculture: flower farms and greenhouses
lead: Syngenta Tecto 500SC is a thiabendazole systemic fungicide for foliar disease prevention and control of botrytis (grey mould) in roses. It moves into plant tissue to protect from inside, which helps stop disease spreading in cool, humid greenhouses.
method: Mix as the label directs and spray evenly over buds, petals, leaves and stems, applying early before disease builds up.
extraSteps: Ventilate greenhouses, avoid wetting flowers and leaves late in the day, and give plants enough space for air to move.
Remove dead petals, infected buds and fallen debris, keep tools and benches clean, and rotate with fungicides from other groups.
